Job Title: Senior Manager – Digital Product & Portfolio Management

Job Location: Jeddah, Saudi Arabia

1. Role Purpose

The Senior Manager – Digital Product & Portfolio Management manages and orchestrates a portfolio of digital products, platforms and business capabilities that enable digital sales growth, customer experience excellence, operational efficiency and transformation. The role provides central business-side product management and portfolio coordination, ensuring initiatives are clearly defined, strategically aligned, commercially justified, prioritized and delivered across an interconnected ecosystem.

Working with business stakeholders, Digital Technology, Architecture, UX/CX, Engineering, Data, Cybersecurity and external partners, the role translates opportunities and customer needs into structured capabilities, product requirements, roadmaps and executable delivery plans. It spans discovery, solution evaluation, backlog readiness, implementation coordination, launch readiness and post-launch optimization.

A key mandate is business-side orchestration of connected capabilities across eCommerce, CRM, customer engagement, Voice of Customer, analytics, AI, automation and partner platforms. The Senior Manager independently leads portfolio analysis, discovery, governance and cross-functional coordination, developing evidence-based recommendations for Director-led strategy, investment prioritization and major decisions. This is a hands-on product and portfolio role—not a traditional PMO or technical engineering role.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Portfolio Strategy, Prioritization & Roadmaps
• Maintain an integrated portfolio roadmap across products, journeys, platforms and strategic initiatives.
• Assess initiatives against business value, customer impact, urgency, effort, readiness, risk, dependencies, reuse and strategic alignment.
• Recommend MVP scope, sequencing, release increments, trade-offs and investment priorities; prepare leadership decision materials.

B. Product Discovery & Business Capability Definition
• Lead discovery with business, customers, UX/CX, analytics, technology and delivery partners.
• Define problems, outcomes, customer journeys, use cases, capabilities, business rules, success measures and requirements.
• Produce business process flows and functional specifications; validate readiness before development.

C. Digital Capability & Ecosystem Orchestration
• Coordinate connected capabilities across eCommerce, CRM, engagement, VoC, analytics, AI, automation and partner ecosystems.
• Clarify platform responsibilities, system handoffs, integration dependencies, business ownership and reuse opportunities.
• Partner with Architecture and Engineering on platform-neutral solution options and cohesive end-to-end customer experiences.

D. Backlog, Requirements & Delivery Readiness
• Maintain product backlogs, epics, stories, acceptance criteria, release scope and requirement traceability.
• Lead refinement and resolve business ambiguities with Business Analysts, Product Owners and delivery teams.
• Assess scope changes and maintain documentation, decisions and ownership across product tools.

E. Cross-Functional Delivery & Product Lifecycle
• Coordinate business-side work from design and build through testing, launch, stabilization and optimization.
• Track dependencies, blockers, risks, scope and decisions across internal teams and vendors; escalate material issues.
• Support integrated release planning, demonstrations, business validation and transition into ongoing operations.

F. Technology & Solution Evaluation
• Work with Architecture and Engineering to evaluate build, buy, reuse and hybrid options against value, fit, integration, scalability, speed and cost.
• Support RFP requirements, evaluation criteria, vendor demonstrations and proof-of-concept assessments.
• Develop business-side recommendations without assuming technical architecture decision authority.

G. Customer Experience, Measurement & Optimization
• Champion usability, accessibility, localization, content readiness and consistent journeys.
• Define product success measures with functional owners and ensure analytics and feedback requirements are embedded.
• Review adoption, conversion, experience and operational performance; recommend post-launch improvements.

H. Portfolio Governance & Stakeholder Coordination
• Operate intake, assessment, prioritization, stage-gate, reporting and escalation processes under Director direction.
• Maintain portfolio visibility of ownership, scope, funding, risks, dependencies, decisions and approvals.
• Prepare executive updates, decision logs, governance forums and cross-functional alignment activities.

I. Financial, Resource & Vendor Support
• Support budgets, forecasts, business cases, capacity plans, procurement inputs and investment analysis.
• Coordinate vendor assessments and business-side performance reviews; monitor commitments and deliverables.
• Track planned versus realized benefits and recommend ways to improve platform and investment value.

J. Risk, Compliance & Release Readiness
• Coordinate inputs from cybersecurity, privacy, data protection, legal, accessibility, brand and quality control owners.
• Coordinate UAT, business and operational readiness, support arrangements, analytics readiness and acceptance evidence.
• Provide business go-live readiness recommendations and track defects and stabilization actions.

3. Qualifications & Experience

Mandatory
• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Digital Business, Product Management or related field.
• 8–12+ years of relevant experience, including 3–5 years in senior digital product, platform or product portfolio responsibilities.
• Demonstrated hands-on ownership of discovery, roadmaps, prioritization, backlogs, requirements, cross-functional delivery and launch readiness.
• Experience managing multiple digital products or connected business capabilities in complex customer-facing environments.
• Understanding of SaaS ecosystems, API integrations and enterprise technology dependencies.
• Strong commercial analysis, stakeholder engagement, problem solving and executive communication.

Highly Preferred
• Digital commerce, B2B platforms, insurance, banking, fintech, telecommunications or similar transactional ecosystems.
• Experience across CRM, engagement, analytics, automation and integrated customer platforms; Salesforce, Sprinklr or Qualtrics exposure advantageous.
• Agile delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or Confluence; vendor and systems-integrator coordination.
• Digital analytics, conversion optimization, customer experience measurement and investment governance.

Preferred Certifications
• PSPO, CSPO, SAFe Product Manager/Product Owner or comparable product certification.
• Relevant Agile, portfolio or programme management certifications; practical product ownership matters more than certification alone.

4. Expected Deliverables
• Integrated digital product portfolio roadmap and prioritization framework.
• Product discovery outputs, business capability maps and cross-platform dependencies.
• Backlogs, requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and release readiness assessments.
• Portfolio governance reporting, executive decision papers and investment recommendations.
• Vendor/solution evaluations, product performance and value-realization reports.

5. Key Performance Indicators
• Portfolio roadmap alignment and readiness; quality of discovery and requirements.
• Backlog readiness and reduction of requirement-related rework.
• Cross-platform dependency resolution and business launch readiness.
• Governance decision turnaround and stakeholder alignment.
• Product adoption and realized value against approved objectives.
• Targets and measurement methods will be set against the approved portfolio and operating model.

About The Role

We're looking for a structured, data-driven Senior Product Manager to shape and deliver digital financial products for a growing fintech startup. You'll own product direction and priorities, working closely with business, engineering, design and compliance to turn customer needs into practical, measurable product improvements.

The role covers the full product lifecycle, from discovery and strategy through launch and growth, with a focus on payments, digital wallets and BNPL.

What you'll do

• Define and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for your assigned product area, aligning customer needs with business objectives.
• Lead customer discovery through user interviews, product insights, and market and competitor research, translating findings into clear problem statements and business cases.
• Own and prioritise the product backlog, balancing customer value, business impact, regulatory requirements, technical dependencies and delivery effort.
• Develop product requirements documents, user stories and acceptance criteria that give engineering and design clear direction.
• Define MVP scope and success measures, coordinating go-to-market planning, release readiness and post-launch improvements with relevant teams.
• Partner with engineering and design on backlog refinement, sprint planning and delivery, resolving scope questions and managing product trade-offs.
• Work with risk and compliance teams to incorporate applicable SAMA regulations, KYC and AML requirements into product design and delivery.
• Define business and product requirements for API integrations with banks, payment providers and third parties, partnering with technical teams on implementation.
• Establish product KPIs and contribute to OKRs, using funnel analysis, conversion, retention and other relevant metrics to evaluate performance.
• Use customer feedback, product analytics and experiments, including A/B testing where appropriate, to guide prioritisation and continuous improvement.
• Communicate product priorities, progress, dependencies, risks and results clearly to senior stakeholders.

What you bring

• 6+ years of product management experience, including 3 years in fintech.
• A proven track record of taking digital products from discovery through launch and growth, with measurable outcomes.
• Hands-on product experience in one or more relevant areas: digital payments, wallets, banking, lending, BNPL or open banking.
• Experience defining product strategy, building roadmaps and making prioritisation decisions using frameworks such as RICE or MoSCoW.
• Working knowledge of the Saudi fintech landscape, including relevant SAMA requirements and local payment systems.
• Strong technical understanding of APIs, financial integrations and system dependencies, with the ability to discuss requirements and trade-offs with engineering teams.
• Strong product analytics skills, including experience with tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or Google Analytics.
• Experience working with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.
• Proficiency with Jira and Confluence, and familiarity with Figma for reviewing designs and collaborating with designers.
• Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to communicate complex requirements clearly.
• Strong written and spoken English and Arabic.

Nice to have

• Experience launching and scaling fintech products in Saudi Arabia or other GCC markets.
• SQL and/or Power BI skills for independent analysis and reporting.
• Experience with core banking integrations.
• Exposure to PCI DSS requirements or information security considerations in financial products.
• CSPO or PSPO certification, or an MBA.
